title: nepeta juncea subsp. xylorhiza
intro: Nepeta juncea subsp. xylorhiza, commonly known as Mountain Mint, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include its use in treating digestive issues, fever, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Mint are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for its medicinal properties include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, which may help to soothe and calm the body.
